note: Illustrative shape example pinned by P-0014; timestamps, identifiers, and key material are not compatibility constants.

challenge_shape.lifetime_rule: expires_at - issued_at must not exceed the five-minute authenticated-command maximum

governed_fact.fact_digest: the exact remote-authority-record digest of the issued PrincipalBindingV1

auxiliary_fact.fact_digest: the DSSE envelope digest of the consumed challenge presentation

outcome_rules.allow: success whose application_effect_digest equals the governed-fact digest
outcome_rules.identical_replay: IdempotentReplay disclosing the prior result without a duplicate fact
outcome_rules.changed_re_presentation_same_principals: IdempotencyConflict under the Workspace-global successful-application key rule
outcome_rules.consumed_or_expired_challenge: authorized application failure with problem code proof.state.conflict that retains its signed decision
outcome_rules.malformed_closure_foreign_envelope_or_ke: input schema mismatch rejected before any transaction
